prototypeComplianceSchemeUploadErrors.howToFix: Add a chemistry code. Use one of: PBA (Lead-acid), NCD (Ni-Cad), NMH (Nickel Metal Hydride), LIO (Lithium-ion), ALK (Alkaline), OTH (Other).
Enter weight as a whole number. Enter kilograms without units, commas or letters – for example, 1000 for 1,000 kg.
Add a category code. Use one of: GEN (General use), CBC (Coin & button cells), LMT (Light means of transport), OTH (Other).
